items.title: Bottler Coca-Cola HBC says no notification from Russia on asset changes
items.summary: Nov 6 () - Bottler Coca-Cola HBC, the bottling partner for Coca-Cola in Central and Eastern Europe and Africa, said on ‌Thursday it had not received any notification from Russia of ‌any changes to its operations in the country. • It said in a statement ​it had taken note of recent speculation about its Russian operations.
